summary: We made a one page comic told by Sojourner, the first rover on Mars. The robot tells its own life story: how it was built and named, how it explored rocks, and how it finally went silent. We used real facts from NASA’s official websites. We think this story is important because we really like understanding it, and most kids only hear about the new rovers. Sojourner was the first one, and it opened the way for all the others. We want other kids to meet it and feel close to it, like we did.
details:
Our project is a one page comic where Sojourner, the first rover on Mars, tells its own life story. Readers follow the robot from the beginning, when it was built and named, through its trip to Mars, its work studying rocks, until the day it went silent. All the facts come from NASA’s official websites.

We drew all the pictures by hand, and we used Chat GPT to color the drawings.

We love drawing, painting with watercolors and telling stories. We have entered other storytelling contests before, and when we saw this one was from NASA, we wanted to take part because we love space.

The benefit of a comic is that it’s easy and fun to read for kids our age. Having the robot tell the story makes it feel like a friend, not a list of facts. We want other kids to learn that before today’s big rovers there was a small one about the size of a microwave that opened the way. We were careful to check every fact, because the story is real.
